prompt:
You are a formal verification assistant. The following Dafny program fails Dafny verification.

=== PROGRAM ===
method suma_componentes(V : array?<int>) returns (suma : int)

  ensures  suma == suma_aux(V, 0)	// x = V[0] + V[1] + ... + V[N - 1]
  
{
    
  var n : int ;

  assert V != null ;						      // P

  assert 0 <= V.Length <= V.Length && 0 == suma_aux(V, V.Length) ; // P ==> pmd(n := V.Length ; x := 0, I) 

  	n := V.Length ;  // n := N
  	suma := 0 ;

  assert 0 <= n <= V.Length && suma == suma_aux(V, n) ;		      // I
  
  while n != 0
  
    invariant 0 <= n <= V.Length && suma == suma_aux(V, n)	// I
    decreases n							// C
    
  {

    assert 0 <= n <= V.Length && suma == suma_aux(V, n) && n != 0 ; 	// I /\ B ==> R

    assert 0 <= n - 1 <= V.Length ;
    assert suma + V[n - 1] == suma_aux(V, n - 1) ; 			// R : pmd(x := x + V[n - 1], R1)

    	suma := suma + V[n - 1] ;

    assert 0 <= n - 1 <= V.Length && suma == suma_aux(V, n - 1) ; 	// R1 : pmd(n := n - 1, I)

    	n := n - 1 ;

    assert 0 <= n <= V.Length && suma == suma_aux(V, n) ; 		// I

  }

  assert 0 <= n <= V.Length && suma == suma_aux(V, n) && n == 0 ;  	// I /\ ¬B ==> Q 	

  assert suma == suma_aux(V, 0)	;					// Q 
  
}



function suma_aux(V : array?<int>, n : int) : int

  // suma_aux(V, n) = V[n] + V[n + 1] + ... + V[N - 1]

  requires V != null			// P_0
  requires 0 <= n <= V.Length		// Q_0
  
  decreases V.Length - n		// C_0
  
  reads V
  
{
    
  if (n == V.Length) then 0 					// Caso base:      n = N
                     else V[n] + suma_aux(V, n + 1)		// Caso recursivo: n < N
  
}

=== DAFNY ERROR ===
program.dfy(3,27): Error: function precondition could not be proved

program.dfy(52,13): Related location: this proposition could not be proved
   |
52 |   requires V != null			// P_0
   |              ^^

program.dfy(9,2): Error: assertion might not hold

Dafny program verifier finished with 1 verified, 2 errors

=== COUNTEREXAMPLE ===
For the error at line 3: At initial state: V = null. At post-state: V = null.
For the error at line 9: At initial state: V = null.

Analyze the failure and respond with ONLY a valid JSON object — no explanation, no markdown, no code fences. Use exactly this structure:

{
  "spec_element": "<one of: requires | invariant | ensures>",
  "proof_obligation": "<one of: initiation | preservation | bridge>",
  "diagnosis": "<explanation of what broke and why>",
  "repair": "<the corrected Dafny specification line that restores the intended behavior>"
}

Definitions:
- requires: the precondition that must hold before the method executes
- invariant: the loop invariant that must hold throughout the loop
- ensures: the postcondition that the method must guarantee on return
- initiation: the precondition does not establish the invariant at loop entry
- preservation: the loop body does not maintain the invariant
- bridge: the invariant and loop exit condition do not imply the postcondition
